_doc: Karate defense (story 6.3, AD-24, CAP-19). Non-violent: block, dodge and Kiai stance; bullies only stumble back, nothing is hurt. `belts` is the stat table per belt id (the player's belt is state.players[i].karate.belt; the white belt is the baseline, later belts add rows): kiaiRadius (px), kiaiCooldown (s), blockWindow (s a block can be held before the guard drops), dodgeDistance (px), dodgeCooldown (s), stumbleDuration (s a stumbling bully is out), aergerReduction (Aerger levels a Kiai that stumbled a bully takes off, only while the level is within chase.json level.defendMaxLevel). Mut (courage) is the 0..1 pool every move spends: blockCost per absorbed contact (a parry is free), blockDrain per second of holding, dodgeCost, kiaiCost; it refills at `regen` per second after `regenDelay`. Timings: parryWindow = a contact in the first seconds of a block is a parry (+parryXp), dodgeTime / dodgeGrace = roll length and extra invulnerable time, kiaiTime = shout stance, recover* = the pause after a move (a dropped guard is slower). moveMult scales walking speed per state. Stumble: `step` is how long the scripted step backwards lasts (the rest of stumbleDuration the bully is dizzy), `kiaiDistance` / `bounceDistance` how far, `bounceScale` shortens the block bounce; wobbleHz / wobbleRad the sway. Bubbles: how many speech bubbles the module may show at once.
